scopePreparation.claimText:
## Offline module-progress report — chatgpt:39c2b591d7e5/estate_coordination

Under Jacob's standing autonomous estate mandate, with root retaining independent receiving and normal source integration.

### Learner outcome and current source

Add `canvaspilot export-module-progress COURSE_ID --out progress.html [--module-id ID]`. A learner can currently inspect the accepted module-progress digest as JSON through the CLI, Python or MCP, but cannot retain a readable, printable course-module progress report that opens without CanvasPilot or a network connection.

Current main was read again at 2026-10-08 14:59 UTC: `a5ce672e5b3580c1f52e13c49eefee830f11346c`, tree `0661a7005e577864cb87bc41e0e715409c92ee76`, 948 complete leaves. There is no AGENTS.md in that tree. Existing CLI blob `545ec52f31b694a351e9a41a68e52a34c49db532` has no such command; the unchanged module-progress reader is `a9d3e4bbea22067f76110f03a5f31a5bc9d8de05`. A native baseline command witness will be preserved before implementation.

### Exact source fence

- New `src/canvaspilot/module_progress_export.py`: call the existing `CanvasAPI.module_progress` reader once, render one bounded self-contained HTML report, and create an explicitly selected new output file.
- Separate additive parser/dispatch spans in `src/canvaspilot/cli.py`, preserving all existing commands byte-for-byte outside those spans.
- Focused renderer/process/browser controls under distinctly named test/receiving files, `docs/module-progress-export.md`, and a small additive README usage paragraph.
- Own native source and evidence under `/Users/me/hamon-canvas-module-export-39c2b591-v1`.

The visible HTML will preserve Canvas-reported module states, all-versus-one rules, sequential-progress setting, prerequisite identities, original item requirement types and thresholds, completed/incomplete/unknown/not-reported distinctions, remaining-work context, original order and source coverage diagnostics. It will also retain the complete normalized reader result as exact downloadable JSON, explicitly distinct from unobserved raw provider responses. No local percentage, access decision or module-completion inference will replace the upstream report.

The report opens and prints without scripts, external resources, browser storage, or a running service. It is a saved observation, not current Canvas state. It contains no learner-editable notes/checks, and performs no mark-read, completion, submission, grade or other provider write. Existing output entries are protected; a failed read or render produces no partial successful report.

### Ownership and qualification

Fresh project issue/PR reads, the module-progress issue #39 discussion, current source and all 414 current HAMON #140 comments were inspected. No matching offline module-progress consumer was found. The integrated module-progress #39/#46 reader remains the source of truth. Page packet #54, assignment-study workspace #57, agenda #55, announcement CLI #58, grade review #47/#50, discussion #52, quiz CLI, inbox, client/broker/provider/pagination and authentication owners retain their exact spans. API/MCP/bundle/dependencies/workflows are outside this source fence.

Qualification will use authored module/course responses grounded in the current reader, real native CLI/client calls against disposable loopback HTTP, complete report and JSON readback, refusal/recovery controls and an actual offline desktop/phone browser. No school account, browser profile, real learner data, model call, paid service or live deployment will be used. Exact original failures and source pins remain retained; independent receiving and current-source hosted gates precede integration.

This is an external source-contribution reservation, not a resident goal, task, attempt or native lease. Existing owner checkouts are read/copy only.

    module-progress     Inspect reported module progress and requirements
